items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: And another band I played with was... Ross, he was one-eyed fellow.

ctx.x: Okay, why that doesn't play like that?

No, and I couldn't do too much on the drum board, I'm telling you it was pitiful. And another band I played with was, uh, uh, did you see what was the name of this young? I forget his name, but Ross, he was one-eyed fellow. He played way up from a place called Cherokee Man. I think he was on the label this night. I know he was a holler at night. He was playing up. He couldn't play up with one piece after the bucket got a hold of it. And when I, da He played that a fellow way over a couple of doors from there. Why…
That's not a head of it.
